policy: Keep exact immutable old release, source banks, numbered cues and all unaffected item recordings. Never overwrite a bank. Shared current group/options have one authoritative transcript, so no substantive text rewrite for a single mode while keeping contradictory audio in the other. Manifest does not authorize synthesis, migration, or verification promotion.

units.proposal: Practice only using the exact unchanged published English; aim for clean natural emphasis on wrench (no added words and no alterations to phrase meaning).
